label: Claude Opus 5.5
output:
Rick, I need to say this now so it's not hanging over Thanksgiving.

I'm really mad about the Gary thing. Not at Gary, at you. You told him I'd list his house for 1% "family rate" without ever asking me. One percent. I have never said that number to anybody. My listing side is 2.5%, and that's not me being greedy, that's what it costs to do the job right.

I still took it seriously because you're my brother and I didn't want to make you look bad. I gave up my whole Saturday, drove down from north Phoenix to Chandler, did the walkthrough, pulled comps, and printed a full listing packet. Six hours plus the drive. Then Sunday night he goes with ListLite for $3,995 and "no hard feelings." Fine, that's his call. But when I called you, all I got was "that's business sis, can't win em all." It wasn't your business. It was my Saturday.

And this morning you've already given Denise my cell so she can "pick my brain" about her rental. Same thing happened with your softball buddy two years ago and I let it go. I'm not letting it go this time.

Here's how it works from now on. You don't give out my number and you don't quote my commission to anybody, ever. If someone wants to talk to me, ask me first. Every time. I'll decide if I have the time and what I charge.

I'm not calling Denise. You set that one up, so you can tell her.

I'll always help actual family. Mom, the kids, anybody in this family can call me about anything and I'll never charge for advice. But I'm not going to keep doing free work so you can look like the big shot with your friends. That's not fair to me, and I think you know it.

I love you and I'll be at your place for Thanksgiving. I just need you to actually hear this.
